meta.name: playwright-cli
meta.description: Automate browser interactions, test web pages and work with Playwright tests.

copy.tagline: 驱动浏览器自动执行网页操作与测试
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要频繁验证网页功能并模拟用户操作
copy.tagline_en: Drive browsers to run web page actions and tests automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to verify websites or simulate what users do in a browser

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 能驱动一个外部浏览器：打开网页、点击、输入、填表、截图、录屏、查看控制台与网络日志，并处理与 Playwright 测试相关的任务。
howto.when: 当用户要求打开网页、在页面上点击或输入、截取页面状态，或处理 Playwright 测试相关任务时触发。

say.text: 打开 example.com，告诉我页面标题和网址。
say.note: 会先打开该页面并生成页面快照。

say.text: 把这个页面上所有“Sign in”链接的位置找出来。
say.note: 会在页面快照中搜索并显示匹配位置。

say.text: 在搜索框里输入“hello”并回车。
say.note: 会定位输入框、填入内容并按下回车。

howto.what_en: This skill lets Claude drive an external browser: open pages, click, type, fill forms, take screenshots and videos, read console and network logs, and handle Playwright-test-related tasks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a user asks to open a webpage, click or type on a page, capture page state, or work with Playwright testing tasks.

say_en.text: Open example.com and tell me the page title and URL.
say_en.note: Opens the page and produces a snapshot.

say_en.text: Find all the “Sign in” links on this page and show where they are.
say_en.note: Searches the snapshot and returns matching locations.

say_en.text: Type “hello” in the search box and press Enter.
say_en.note: Fills the input and presses Enter.
